source.title: Primary School Education Curriculum Design — French, Grade 5 (Revised 2024)
source.notes: Read directly from 'grade 5 designs/GRADE-5-FRENCH-Curriculum-Designs.pdf' via the Read tool (no pages param, per standing environment note). Essence statement: foreign language taught non-formally at Primary level, targeting basic proficiency equivalent to A1/YCT2, guided by social-constructivism and environmental theories. Same 9-theme, 3-strand (Listening and Speaking / Reading / Writing) structure as Grade 6/7/8/9 French (see curriculum-reference/grade-6/french.json), same ISBN 978-9914-43-996-0 as Grade 6, same informal 'tu' register throughout (no formal 'vous' register drilling, unlike Grade 8). Time allocation: Listening and Speaking 27 lessons, Reading 18 lessons, Writing 9 lessons, +6 lessons showcasing (54 + 6 total).

scopeNotes: include: 'Comment tu t'appelles ? Je m'appelle …, Je suis une fille, Comment ça va ?, Voici mon ami' and 'Qui est-ce… ? C'est / Voici' as the named model sentence patterns

assessmentSignal: Listening/Speaking rubric rewards fluent speech patterns (articulation, pronunciation, intonation, rhythm, pacing), mastery of vocabulary/expressions and correct sentence structures in oral interactions, and ability to recognize targeted sounds from audio text and generalize to other words with similar sounds. Reading rubric rewards inferring meaning of words/expressions (including implicit clues, not just explicitly-stated ones), fluency (smoothness/pace/intonation/pauses matching punctuation), and word-recognition accuracy (correct decoding, articulation, tone). Writing rubric rewards clear/readable handwriting with proper spacing, and correct spelling/grammar/sentence structure maintained throughout (not just in isolated instances).
notes: Grade 5 French has the exact same 9-theme, 3-strand (Listening and Speaking / Reading / Writing) shape and the exact same 9 theme names as Grade 6/7/8/9 French (Greetings and Introductions, Family, My Surroundings, Time, Fun and Enjoyment, Foods and Drinks, My Body, Weather and Environment, Getting Around) — informal 'tu' register throughout (no formal 'vous' register drilling, unlike Grade 8). Two content differences worth flagging vs Grade 6: (1) Grade 5's 'My Body' theme (1.7/2.7/3.7) covers BODY-PART NAMING AND FUNCTION ('Ma bouche est pour manger...'), whereas Grade 6's 'My Body' theme covers GROOMING/HYGIENE vocabulary only — these are genuinely different content despite the identical theme title, do not merge or backport; (2) Grade 5's Reading sub-strand 2.3 has a Specific-Learning-Outcomes column that says 'about the nuclear family' (apparent copy/paste carry-over from 2.2) while its own Suggested Learning Experiences and Key Inquiry Question both clearly concern classroom-item vocabulary matching the 'My Surroundings' theme — treated the learning-experiences content as authoritative, per CURRICULUM-MINING-GUIDE.md discipline of recording rather than silently resolving such source mismatches. Skills built as 27 files in web/src/skills/frenchG5/ (9 themes x 3 strands: Speaking/Reading/Writing), following the exact frenchG6/frenchG7 file/strand/code pattern (strand ids g5-fr-listening-speaking / g5-fr-reading / g5-fr-writing, codes LS.1-9 / R.1-9 / W.1-9).
